title: Joint Observer-Based Output-Feedback Robust Guidance and Control Funnel Synthesis
summary: A joint guidance and robust observer-based output-feedback synthesis framework is developed for discrete-time nonlinear systems subject to bounded process disturbances and measurement noise. The method co-designs a reference trajectory, time-varying Luenberger observer and observer-based linear output-feedback gains, and coupled ellipsoidal funnels that certify conditioned-invariant bounds on tracking and estimation errors.
